request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work (law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, company and plant
documents) using ONLY the documents in the current folder, one text file per document; README.md lists them with their rank. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need: search in English and in Italian, follow references from one article or annex to another, and read the whole section before you rely on it.

Rules:
- Use only the files. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- Answer only if a passage states the answer for the exact subject asked about (the same device, the same article
  and paragraph, the same kind of verification, the same deadline). A passage about a neighbouring subject does not
  answer the question: then the kind is "unknown" and the value is null. A question about something that happened
  (the date of the last check, whether something is overdue today) is "unknown" unless a passage records that event.
- A passage marked "corrected by the corrigendum" already shows the corrected wording: reason with it. The old
  wording, given in the mark, is no longer valid.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the passages, one by one. A repeal or an
  application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a date is still fully in
  force on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does not yet bind on earlier days.
- When passages of different rank disagree, the higher rank wins: law, then guidance, then manufacturer's manual,
  then company procedure, then plant record. Between two Italian texts, a legislative decree (D.Lgs.) wins over a
  ministerial decree (DM). Say which one wins.
- A row of a table belongs to the thing named in that same row. Read the row of the item asked about, not a
  neighbouring row. When the question itself states a condition ("if it were in regular use", "built in 2017"),
  reason with that condition.
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / by which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "how often / for how
  long / within what time" is "duration"; "can / may / is / does / must" is "boolean"; "which / what (several
  things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition is "text" (one short sentence naming every element asked for).
- Point at the evidence: for every passage you rely on, copy word for word the sentence, or the table row, that
  states what you use. Copy exactly, without changing a character; do not join text from two places.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not state it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "what the passages say and how it leads to the answer, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y", "P6M", "P45D", "PT1H" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "evidence": [{"file": "<file name>", "quote": "<copied exactly from that file, one sentence or one table row>"}]}
request.prompt:
Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: From which date do Articles 26 to 42 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 (notification of conformity assessment bodies) apply?

What the fact store already holds on this question (facts taken earlier from these same documents, each with the
sentence it comes from). They are leads, not the answer: a fact can be incomplete, about a neighbouring subject,
or wrong. Check each one you use against the files, and search further whenever they do not settle the question.
The store's own answer: "2024-01-20" - Articles 26 to 42 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 apply from 20 January 2024, as set out in the Corrigendum, point 11.
Facts (subject | relation | value | condition | [document, place]):
- Articles 26 to 42 | applies from | 20 January 2024 (2024-01-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 11] | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 January 2024 ’."
- Regulation | applies from | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | if: However, the following Articles shall apply from the following dates | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 10] | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’."
- Article 6(7) and Articles 48 and 52 | applies from | 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 13] | sentence: "read: ‘ 19 July 2023 ’."
- conformity assessment body | has obligation | shall apply as general guidance | [REG, Art. 30(11)] | sentence: "A conformity assessment body shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks are informed of, the relevant standardisation activities and the activities of the notified body coordination group established under Article 42 and shall apply as general guidance the administrative decisions and documents produced as a result of the work of"
- Chapter VI of this Regulation (mutatis mutandis to such products) | applies from | 19 July 2023 (2023-07-19) | if: mutatis mutandis to such products instead of Article 11 of that Directive… | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 7] | sentence: "read: ‘ 19 July 2023 ’."
- manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 | has obligation | shall apply one of the conformity assessment procedures | [REG, Art. 25(1)] | sentence: "The manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the conformity assessment procedures referred to in paragraphs 2, 3 and 4."
- manufacturer or his authorised representative | has obligation | shall apply the procedure (shall apply the procedure for assessment of conformity) | if: Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV | [DIR, Art. 12(2)] | sentence: "Where the machinery is not referred to in Annex IV, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall apply the procedure for assessment of conformity with internal checks on the manufacture of machinery provided for in Annex VIII."
- notified body | defined as | conformity assessment body notified in accordance with this Regulation | [REG, Art. 3(30)] | sentence: "(30) ‘notified body’ means a conformity assessment body notified in accordance with this Regulation;"
- Article 6(2) to (6), (8) and (11) and Articles 47 and 53(3) | applies from | 20 July 2024 (2024-07-20) | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 14] | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 July 2024 ’."
- notified body | has obligation | any conformity assessment activities | if: on request | [REG, Art. 40(1)] | sentence: "(d) on request, any conformity assessment activities performed within the scope of its notification and any other activity performed, including cross-border activities and subcontracting."
- conformity assessment body | has obligation | shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel | [REG, Art. 30(11)] | sentence: "A conformity assessment body shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks are informed of, the relevant standardisation activities and the activities of the notified body coordination group established under Article 42 and shall apply as general guidance the administrative decisions and documents produced as a result of the work of"
- products placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC | placing allowed until | 20 January 2027 (2027-01-20) | if: placed on the market in conformity with Directive 2006/42/EC before 20 January 2027 | [CORR, Corrigendum, point 6] | sentence: "read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’."
